integrity: Analytic proof and reproducible symbolic/numerical corroboration; no independent validation or certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: One exact planar cubic global-center system, fixed positive parameter, Euclidean-area sampling on expanding invariant energy sublevels; no claims for Euclidean disks or perturbations. Closely related same-system work already supplies the elliptic period and its large-amplitude asymptotic. The original contribution assessed is the across-orbit area distribution, Pareto law and mean coefficient; unindexed equivalent work remains possible.
title: A Pareto law and logarithmically divergent mean for area-sampled periods of a cubic global center
